description: DeriveCallGraphComponent(f) re-walks f's whole reachable cone on every wake (collect_static_graph) and discovers it one blocked evaluation per layer (waits on absent StaticCallees, AND-satisfied), then runs a private SCC (strong_component). transport.rs statically_reaches is a second private walker over the same edges, reading StaticCallees settled for every visited function. Measured on 00181_enum_reduce_operator_ref: seeing one more edge from main costs six more component evaluations (eight blocked) and three readiness-caused SeedRoot evaluations; job starts 443 -> 454. Under dynamic edges (fz-kdt.98.3) every edge movement would re-walk every cone containing it. Replace both walkers with one cumulative fact Reaches(f): the functions reachable from f, defined as edges(f) joined with Reaches(g) for each direct callee g, reading only the direct callees' facts; an absent Reaches(g) reads as the empty set with a subscription, so a callee that appears later grows the set through the ordinary ascent, and mutual recursion converges as chaotic iteration the way ReturnType does. Recursive(f) is f in Reaches(f). CallGraphComponent(f) is the smallest g in Reaches(f) plus f itself with f in Reaches(g), read from those members' Reaches facts. The transport cut's one-way question becomes one fact read: owner in Reaches(from). Delete collect_static_graph, strong_component, the per-layer wait ladder and statically_reaches. The edge set does not change here, so CallGraphComponent and Recursive values are identical, the corpus canon is byte-identical, and the blocked discovery evaluations disappear: the 00181 job-start census and the json_roundtrip DeriveCallGraphComponent counts must go DOWN, never up. First commit of fz-kdt.98; fz-kdt.98.1 (the construction edge, built and held uncommitted) lands on top of it so no pin is ever raised.
title: Reachability is one monotone formula per function; the component cone walk and the transport reachability walk go away
